reviews.text: Love their service, they're good..
Excellent service. My dog ​​left very happy and Luciana was very affectionate. We will definitely return.

We are very happy with Luciana's work. She removes all the knots from our dog's fur and brushes him so well he looks like a fluffy pom-pom. She is very kind and you can tell she has a way with animals and takes great care of them. Thank you so much for your work, Luciana!
I love how they work! They make my dog ​​look gorgeous and always treat her with so much love! I wouldn't change groomers for anything!!!
I have a Persian kitten who needs a haircut and a bath. I only dare to take her to Luciana because she treats her with so much love and professionalism. I recommend her one hundred percent.
Patxi, my dog, loves going there, there must be a reason...excellent service
Luciana is the best hairdresser in Madrid, I highly recommend her.
A very good salon, the groomer is beyond praise! We were there for the first time on Saturday and will continue to bring our little feline companions.

I'm always delighted when I take my Django there; they make him look gorgeous. I could just eat him up with kisses because he smells so good... Luciana is a sweetheart and treats the dogs with so much love.
Thank you for your kindness towards my dog ​​and for your professionalism.

A very negative experience. As a regular customer, I was told not to bring my dog ​​anymore because "he was very mischievous and bit her." She said he was too much trouble... He's a 4 kg Maltese. I asked if it was about money, and she told me not to come back. It seems unbelievable, but it's true. I've never been turned away from anywhere before... I felt terrible.
She takes excellent care of my dog, reduces her stress, and gives her all the love she needs to feel comfortable during her grooming session. She's a truly excellent professional.

Today I took Lalu back to the groomer and she looks gorgeous! Thank you, Luciana, for treating us so well. Kisses.

I've been taking my dogs to Luciana for 14 years and I couldn't be happier. The service is unbeatable and the dogs are always happy with her; they even make new friends. Thank you so much for taking such good care of them, pampering them, and making them look so beautiful.

I love the experience my dog ​​has at Luciana's grooming salon. The professionals who work there are very kind and gentle with the animals. My dog ​​always leaves with a smile on his face and smelling wonderful.

They provide personalized attention and take the time to understand each dog's specific needs. The prices are reasonable, and the quality of service is excellent.

I recommend Luciana to all dog owners looking for a reliable and professional place for their pets' grooming and beauty. Five stars, without a doubt!
The girls are so lovely and treated Muffin with so much care and professionalism. He looks absolutely gorgeous! Thank you so much, ladies, we'll be back!
We've been taking our dachshund for years and we're delighted ❤️
Perfect service and treatment

Luciana is a true professional, an excellent hairdresser, and a very loving person with my little Roque. It's not easy to find someone who meets all these requirements, and once you find her, you can't help but recommend her.

Luciana is a wonderful groomer. We've been taking our cat Kipling there for three years now and we're delighted. She's undoubtedly a true professional who loves her job as much as she loves our pets. Highly recommended.
My Westie Mimi was terrified when I adopted her... now she's so happy at grooming time. Animals know where to find love!

My dog, who is a wirehaired dachshund, has been coming here for 3 years and it's the best place in the neighborhood. He always gets his hair done perfectly and you can tell they treat him really well because he always comes in delighted. They are so loving and do everything with great care.

The service is beyond exquisite!! Luciana is a sweetheart, and the care she shows my dog ​​is incredible. He never wants to leave the salon!!
Every time we go, my little guy is thrilled and comes out looking gorgeous with a haircut he's never had anywhere else.
Don't hesitate!!! You'll love it!

Incredible service! You can tell how much Luciana loves dogs. Our little guy gets so excited when we go to see her; he'd happily stay with her. She'll definitely always be our go-to groomer. 101% recommended.

A wonderful place where my Shih Tzu (Zuky) thoroughly enjoys her bath. She comes out completely relaxed because Luciana is so gentle with the animals, dedicating the time each one needs. She's very loving and kind. I've been bathing my little one with her for nine years, and I would never go anywhere else because the peace and quiet I get with her is irreplaceable. Thank you, Luciana, for the love you always show my little one! 😍❤️
My experience has always been very good. I've been taking my dog ​​there for years and they do an excellent job, treating her with lots of love.
Thank you! 💖 …
We loved it! We'll be back!!!
I've already taken my furry friend 3 times and I'm very happy with the service 😊 …
